prompt: An update is three atomic block writes in this order: W1 writes the new data block, W2 points the inode at it, W3 marks it used in the bitmap. A crash can happen after any prefix of the writes.

trace.label: How many different crash states (including none and all)?
Crash after W1 only. The disk is
choices: consistent (the new block is simply unused)

trace.label: Crash after W1 and W2. The disk is
choices: inconsistent (the inode uses a block the bitmap calls free)

explain: A prefix of three writes can have length 0, 1, 2 or 3: four states. Pointing at a block that is not marked used risks it being handed out again, which is why write order matters.
